snippet.title: Pre-Alpha Trailer — ENTROPIA
snippet.description:
Entropia enters the Pre-Alpha stage and launches its first demo!
After months of work, we’re ready to show you the first results. This is just the beginning — with your support, we’ll keep pushing forward the game according to our roadmap: https://entropiathegame.com/en/roadmap

Support Entropia
○ Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/c/junefolks/
○ Boosty: https://boosty.to/entropiathegame
○ Add to Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2809220/Entropia/

Follow Entropia
○ Steam: https://entropiathegame.com/steam
○ Discord: https://entropiathegame.com/discord
○ X: https://entropiathegame.com/twitter
○ Telegram: https://entropiathegame.com/telegram
○ VK: https://entropiathegame.com/vk

Music: Nerdy — Be a Warrior (Entropia OST)

Stay in touch: 
○ Official website: https://entropiathegame.com
○ Press: press@entropiathegame.com
○ Info: info@entropiathegame.com

Entropia is an original tactical first-person shooter featuring brutal battles in a fully destructible environment. Immerse yourself in tactical team combat with a vast arsenal of weapons, gadgets, and customization!
Made by gamers with love.

—

#Entropia #EntropiaTheGame #Indie
